schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE clienti (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    nome TEXT NOT NULL,
    cognome TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    telefono TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE immobili_vendita (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    client_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES clienti(id),
    indirizzo TEXT NOT NULL,
    tipo_immobile TEXT NOT NULL,
    valore_mercato NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (valore_mercato > 0),
    data_inserimento DATE NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE contratti (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    immobile_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES immobili_vendita(id),
    data_contratto DATE NOT NULL,
    importo NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (importo >= 0),
    tipo_contratto TEXT NOT NULL
);

query: WITH clienti_stats AS (SELECT c.id AS cliente_id, c.nome, c.cognome, COUNT(iv.id) AS num_immobili, SUM(co.importo) AS totale_contratti, AVG(co.importo) AS media_importo, MAX(co.importo) AS max_importo FROM clienti c JOIN immobili_vendita iv ON c.id = iv.client_id JOIN contratti co ON iv.id = co.immobile_id GROUP BY c.id, c.nome, c.cognome HAVING SUM(co.importo) > 100000) SELECT cs.nome, cs.cognome, cs.num_immobili, cs.totale_contratti, cs.media_importo, cs.max_importo, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.totale_contratti DESC) AS posizione FROM clienti_stats cs ORDER BY cs.totale_contratti DESC LIMIT 5;
